findings.observation: Although skin value and shaved crop are recognizable, the source adult’s comparatively small wide-set eyes, long straight nose, narrow upper lip, and mature cheek planes drift into oversized doll eyes, a shortened rounded nose, inflated lips, and juvenile facial proportions, so Zelu no longer reads unmistakably as the same 29-year-old adult.

The summon’s soft-round construction and visibly evident middle are replaced by a sharply pinched waist, pronounced hourglass taper, and disproportionately muscular thighs; the source’s gentle torso-to-hip continuity is not preserved.

Both forearms widen into heavy cylindrical forms and both fists are substantially larger than the summon’s gently full forearms, coherent wrists, and medium natural hands, producing generic chibi limb inflation.
The matte black shaved-close crop preserves the source’s tight crown and close side silhouette without added length, gathered mass, color drift, accent, or emission.

The plum-gray fitted vest, pale shirt, high-waist trousers, offset closures, narrow cuffs, and boots remain recognizable, with zero accessories and zero tattoos as required; however, the source’s single folded plum handkerchief is entirely absent rather than visibly retained as the quiet personal object.

At original resolution, the hair top is near y=138, chin near y=502, and sole bottom near y=1419: the roughly 364 px complete hair-and-head unit is about 28.4 percent of roughly 1281 px standing height, approximately 3.5 heads tall, below the required 32-36 percent / 2.75-3.1-head lock.
Exactly one figure appears with the entire close-cropped head, both empty hands, complete clothing silhouette, both boots, and grounding shadow wholly contained inside generous parchment margins.
The planted three-quarter ready-idle, close crop, high plum collar, separated fists, dark trouser blocks, and sturdy boot shapes form a clear weaponless silhouette at combat-icon scale.

Practical cloth workwear, plain closures, trousers, and boots remain grounded mortal 1-star belongings. No weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
